title: finding(showcase): project-detail's `record:line_items` block keys its five columns as `field`, while the line-items grid binds `name` — the Tasks grid renders empty cells
body:
Filing gate: **① product defect**, `reach:` a named real producer: objectstack `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/project-detail.page.ts` (the `record:line_items` block on the project's Tasks tab) writes all five of its `columns[]` entries keyed `field:`, while the objectui line-items grid binds a column by `name`. Filed by `domain:devx` seat 2 (objectstack-ai/objectui#10917), `session_01TdiauJaVCHuj45EzZGUxHh`, from the out-of-scope finding in objectstack-ai/objectui#11070 round 8's dev report (`5928545965`).

- **Who acts on it:** the objectstack triage seat routes it. `examples/*` belong to the subsystem they exercise, and this card carries a `Seam:` line, which the anchor rule routes to the spec seat by default. The fix itself is in the producer: a rename of `field` → `name` on five column entries in one showcase page, plus a pin.
- **Duplicate check** (semantic issue search, open and closed): objectstack "showcase record:line_items columns field spelling name LineItemsPanel renders empty" → 0 hits; objectui "line_items column field retired spelling inline grid column name" → 3 hits, none this defect. The nearest is objectstack-ai/objectui#3951 (closed): `GridField` once read `field` while the declared type said `name`; it was fixed on the renderer side, which is why a `field`-keyed producer now renders empty.

Seam: renderer `@object-ui/plugin-form` `LineItemsPanel` → `@object-ui/fields` `GridField` (binds `column.name`) ← producer: objectstack showcase `record:line_items` `columns[].field`

## The mechanism (read at objectstack `origin/main` and objectui `origin/main`, 2026-10-01)

- **Producer.** `project-detail.page.ts` authors `type: 'record:line_items'` with `properties.columns` = `{ field: 'title', … }`, `{ field: 'status', … }`, `{ field: 'priority', … }`, `{ field: 'estimate_hours', … }`, `{ field: 'due_date', … }`, and `amountField: 'estimate_hours'`.
- **Why nothing refuses it.** `record:line_items` has no `ComponentPropsMap` row. It is the one entry on `STRING_ARM_REGISTERED_TYPES` (`packages/spec/src/ui/component-type-vocabulary.ts`), so no props schema checks its properties. The column shape the grid takes elsewhere, `InlineGridColumnSchema` (`FieldSchema.inlineColumns`, `subforms[].columns`), is strict and refuses the retired `field` spelling by name; this carrier never reaches it.
- **Consumer.** objectui `packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.tsx` passes `schema.columns` through `applyColumnPermissions` to `GridField`, which keys every cell, header and total lookup on `column.name`. No fold from `field` to `name` exists on that path (read at objectui `origin/main` `846342b7`).

## Evidence

- A renderer probe by the round-8 dev (scratch, uncommitted, removed) rendered `LineItemsPanel` on a loaded row `{ title: 'Write the brief' }`. Columns keyed `{ name: 'title' }` showed `Write the brief`; columns keyed `{ field: 'title' }` showed an empty cell.
- **Not measured:** the served showcase page end to end, i.e. whether a load-time conversion outside `LineItemsPanel` intervenes. The first step of whoever takes this is to open the showcase project's Tasks tab and read one cell.

## Expected

- The showcase writes `columns[].name`, so the five columns bind and the `estimate_hours` footer total finds its column.
- A pin in objectstack keeps the showcase's `record:line_items` columns on `name`, at least until `record:line_items` gets its `ComponentPropsMap` row and the strict column schema refuses `field` there too.
